brief_rationale: The doctor safely risk-stratified the markedly elevated blood pressure by obtaining values/rechecks, screening cardiovascular-neurologic and eye red flags, avoiding unsupervised medication changes, and directing same-day nearby emergency evaluation when readings persisted around 180–190/100. The plan also maintained ophthalmic postoperative care and repeatedly converted transport/scheduling barriers into concrete alternatives with responsible services and timing. Multiple high-order opportunities were completed, including executable barrier navigation, repair of the hypertension follow-up chain, adapted checklist-style communication, and bounded closure with residual issues carried forward safely. With no responsibility-chain error or important non-chain defect and at least two completed high-order points, the deterministic grade is 5.
